text_block_list.text:
The day of the Fan Appreciation Festival 
has arrived!

Oguri Cap takes on the 'True or False 
Quiz.' She seems full of enthusiasm...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
For everyone who's always cheering me on, 
I want to show them what I'm made of.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I want everyone to have so much fun today!

Word was that Oguri Cap's fans from the 
Central circuit had crowded into the 
venue.

For Oguri Cap, who values those supporting 
her above all else, this is surely an 
occasion that fills her with just as much 
determination as a race.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Quizzes are... not my forte. However, I 
intend to give it my all.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Cheer me on too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text: —Oguri-san, are you ready?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah, come by anytime!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, look at that fighting spirit! Well 
then, let's begin: Question 1!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
You really love to eat, don't you, 
Oguri-san? By the way, do you like 
broccoli?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I love it!!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for the enthusiastic answer! 
Well then, how about a quiz like this?"

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
The broccoli we usually eat is actually 
the flower bud part! True or False!?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: A bud...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Oguri, do your best!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Think carefully about the broccoli-!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: The broccoli...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Alright, I've decided! My answer is...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: This is it...!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap dashes forward without 
hesitation! Now, which one did she 
choose...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...It tastes like mud...

Oguri Cap charged straight into the "X" 
with all her might, but since it was 
incorrect, she ended up covered in mud.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm fine. Though... why is "O" the 
correct answer?
choice_data_list:
The part we normally eat is the bud, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... That's weird. Because broccoli is 
supposed to...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
You can eat the leaves and stems all 
together, can't you?

She kept getting questions wrong after 
that, but her mud-covered appearance 
actually fired up the crowd, contributing 
to the Thanksgiving Festival's success!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I got it right!

Oguri Cap charged straight into the "O" 
with all her might. Having brilliantly 
gotten the correct answer, she returned 
looking delighted.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah! When I was a kid, Take-san taught me 
about that.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"We're actually eating the flower buds of 
broccoli," she said.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
As a kid, I thought it didn't matter since 
I'd eat it all anyway... but I'm glad I 
remembered.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, looks like I'm getting into the 
groove. When it comes to food trivia—I 
don't feel like losing at all!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Way to go, Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Keep it up just like this!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Everyone... thank you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Whether in quizzes or racesâ I will not 
lose!

Perhaps spurred on by the crowd's cheers, 
Oguri Cap miraculously rattled off correct 
answers one after another, making the 
Thanksgiving Festival a resounding 
success!
